opening.text: I've been having severe headaches, they're 10 out of 10, and I've had them for 4 years. Also, the thirst and heavy urination started 18 months ago. I'm very thirsty and drink about 15 litres a day, and I pass about as much urine as I drink. My periods stopped 18 months ago, though my first period came at 13.
